The investigations are coming - and Donald Trump and his cronies know it and
are running scared. It's not like Trump hasn't called for Democrats to be
[jailed](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-democrats-seditious-behavior/)
before, but this week, he posted an especially unhinged rant ordering his
Justice Department to launch its own investigations into Dems calling for
probes into his administration when they take control of Congress next year.
"The imprisonment should be against these EXTORTIONISTS," he ridiculously
[declared](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117576401180733840).

His White House lawyer followed up with a threatening letter to the incoming
House Oversight Committee chair. And surprise, surprise… Trump's AG Todd
Blanche suggested he'd do as the president says.

Meanwhile, Trump and his allies continued their sick antics to subvert courts
to deport migrants to places where they're likely to face danger or
persecution, and they moved to cut SNAP benefits for 6 million families and
free school lunches for nearly 2 million children. Here's more on all of that
and other ways the president and his cronies harmed democracy, undermined the
Constitution, and hurt free societies worldwide this week:

#### **Saturday, Nov. 7 - Trump Calls for Jailing Dems**

On Truth Social, Trump
[ordered](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117576401180733840)
his Justice Department to investigate Democratic politicians over their calls
to investigate members of the president's administration.

Trump ridiculously referred to the efforts as "extortion" and called for the
"imprisonment" of Democratic lawmakers.

#### **Sunday, Nov. 8 - AG Blanche Doesn 't Rule Out Locking Up Dems**

On CNN, Attorney General Todd Blanche
[suggested](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/todd-blanche-suggests-
investigating-democrats-trump-orders_n_6af0b78ae4b0d00572fe4343) he would
follow through with Trump's orders and launch investigations into Democrats,
[claiming](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/08/garcia-days-of-us-not-
fighting-back-are-over-01155486) that since the election, some lawmakers "have
done nothing but threaten everything that's happening in this administration."

It's unclear what, if any, crime the Democratic targets of this probe could be
charged with, but Blanche is leaving the door open to putting them in jail
depending "on what the crime is and what they've done."

#### **Monday, Nov. 9** - **Trump Using Loophole to Return Migrants to Home
Countries**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/09/world/africa/trump-deportations-
court-orders-refoulement.html) that more than 110 people who had court-ordered
protections from being deported to their home countries have been removed from
the U.S. by the Trump administration and sent to countries that act as
intermediaries and ultimately hand them off to their home countries, where
they face torture, sexual abuse, or persecution.

Human rights groups told the _Times_ that the move is an effort by the Trump
administration to evade both court orders and international law.

#### **Tuesday, Nov. 10 - Trump Admin Moves to Eliminate SNAP Benefits for
Millions**

The Trump administration [issued](https://public-
inspection.federalregister.gov/2026-22936.pdf) a proposed rule that could
[eliminate](https://abcnews.com/Politics/trump-administration-moves-drop-
millions-snap-proposal/story?id=138031618) SNAP benefits for over 6 million
people. The rule would [prevent](https://apnews.com/article/snap-trump-
administration-school-lunches-2090300a697f6cebe56bbfe1b30ec16a) some people
who receive Temporary Assistance for Needy Families, also known as welfare,
from automatically qualifying for SNAP benefits.

It would also result in nearly 2 million children losing free school meals if
their families don't meet new income eligibility requirements.

#### **Wednesday, Nov. 11 - White House Lawyer Threatens Congress**

Punchbowl News [reported](https://punchbowl.news/article/washington/white-
house-threatens-house-dems-investigations/) that the White House's top lawyer
sent a threatening letter Monday to incoming House Oversight Committee chair
Robert Garcia, claiming that Democratic lawmakers have "evinced a clear intent
to transgress" constitutional limits on congressional investigations and
suggested that efforts to investigate the Trump administration "may cross the
line into blatant criminality."

In response, Garcia [told](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6037540/trump-
white-house-democrats-investigations-robert-garcia) NPR that Democrats will
not "be deterred" or "intimidated by Donald Trump or anyone in the
administration."

#### **Thursday, Nov. 12 - New Rule Leaves 80,000 People At Risk of
Homelessness**

The Trump administration [issued](https://theintercept.com/2026/11/12/hud-
trump-housing-immigration-family-separation/) a new final rule making entire
families ineligible for most federal housing assistance if one member is an
undocumented immigrant, a move that will force families to choose between
separation and being evicted from their homes.

The rule, set to go into effect in mid-December, will result in about 80,000
people - nearly half of them children - losing federal housing assistance and
facing the threat of homelessness.

#### **Friday, Nov. 13 - Supreme Court Set to Hear Asylum Ban Case**

The Supreme Court [agreed](https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-trump-
asylum-
aeed6eb39a46b6f9e56f4b6940a5cfe4?taid=6af75ee9d0eea100019ae606&utm_campaign=TrueAnthem&utm_medium=AP&utm_source=Twitter)
to decide the fate of Trump's executive order banning asylum at the southern
border.

The order was blocked by lower courts for violating the Immigration and
Nationality Act, which specifically allows migrants to claim asylum.
